quarterly_data.signal: Total backlog of firmly committed customer orders was approximately $24.1 billion at June 30, 2026, with approximately 71% targeted for delivery in the next twelve months. Capital expenditures were $446 million in the first six months of 2026 versus $349 million a year earlier; Eaton plans to increase capital expenditures to expand production capacity and expects approximately $1.15 billion of capital expenditures in 2026.
